name: xero-profit-and-loss-review
description: Use for Xero questions like "how did we do last month in Xero", "why did profit drop in Xero", "what moved on our Xero P&L", "why are costs up this month", "what's our gross margin in Xero", "how does this month compare to last year", or a monthly P&L read from Xero — even when the user never says "P&L". Use when the decision is what moved profit, by how much, and whether the move is real or a coding change. Xero only; for QuickBooks use quickbooks-profit-and-loss-review.
